regimeSub: Brent crashes to $87 from $100+ as Hormuz reopening normalizes shipping; risk assets stabilize.
themes: Brent crude -$12.80 to $87.37 as Hormuz reopening (Jun 15-16) finally filters through shipping routes → OPEC+ Aug quota expansion (Jul 6) now dominating over fading geopolitical premium; WTI $81.54 confirms $80 floor broken

KOSPI -10% to 6133 from 6816 as Kimi K3 shock (Jul 20) triggers Samsung/SK Hynix selloff despite TSMC $100bn US capex (Jul 16) → BOK 2.75% hike (Jul 16) ineffective as USDKRW firms to 1466; HBM supply concerns persist

10y yield +2bp to 4.69% with 2s10s at 36bp as Williams 'inflation peaked' call (Jul 15) meets oil relief → CPI 3.5% YoY but energy component easing; Warsh hawkish Sintra stance (Jul 4) keeps Sep hike live
Gold flat at $4047 with VIX stable at 18.67 as crude collapse removes energy inflation tail → risk repricing paused; tech sector rotation (Jul 24) drives defensive positioning away from AI momentum
